Nyirpazony Jewish Cemetery Two

Jewish Cemetery · Nyírpazony, Hungary

Demolished. This is the second of two Jewish cemeteries in Nyírpazony, a companion to the first documented elsewhere in this collection, established as early as 1870, per that year's cadastral map. The village's Jewish community, present from 1736 with two families, never had a full synagogue, only a small shtiebel that no longer exists; the population peaked at 77 in 1848, declining to just 14 (plus 4 baptized Jews) among 3,027 residents by 1941. The community was deported via the Nyíregyháza Ghetto to Auschwitz in June or July 1944; by 1949, no Jews remained in Nyírpazony.
